blocked_protocols.SCP2176_HUMAN_MELANOMA_ALL_CELL_K10: exact full RNA/ATAC matrix assets require authenticated SCP access; official Figshare processed H5ADs are the 833-cell tumor subset

shared_semantics.start: same exact-K input partition within each matched arm set
shared_semantics.unary: same frozen continuous multiscale prototype unary and trust term
shared_semantics.base_pairwise: same Night-15F sparse base capacity and Potts coefficient
shared_semantics.base_self_return: preserved in every primary attribution arm
shared_semantics.bimodal_support: Night-16E RNA/ATAC support factor on each registered sparse edge
shared_semantics.uniform_mass_matched: constant per-scale factor whose base-edge weighted capacity equals BIMODAL_SUPPORT exactly
shared_semantics.permuted_support: stable endpoint-ID/scale-hash permutation of support positions, distribution preserved up to exact weighted mass correction
shared_semantics.single_view_support: RNA-only or ATAC-only edge support, each rescaled to the exact BIMODAL_SUPPORT weighted capacity
shared_semantics.relation_stay_ablation: relation stay set to zero while inherited base self-return is unchanged
shared_semantics.solver: same alpha-expansion implementation and exact-K/no-empty guard

formal_freeze_rule: source, this contract and targeted tests are committed before any SCP2176 melanoma evaluator is run
melanoma_label_rule: SCP2176 labels may mechanically define the tumor-only membership carrier before producer execution; tumour_1/tumour_2 values are read only by the independent evaluator after partitions are locked

interpretation_rules.relation_specific_bimodal_support: BIMODAL_SUPPORT clearly exceeds DIRECT_BASE, UNIFORM_MASS_MATCHED, PERMUTED_SUPPORT, RNA_ONLY_SUPPORT and ATAC_ONLY_SUPPORT on human hippocampus and at least one frozen melanoma protocol
interpretation_rules.single_view: RNA_ONLY_SUPPORT or ATAC_ONLY_SUPPORT matches or exceeds BIMODAL_SUPPORT
interpretation_rules.no_independent_transfer: development attribution holds but no frozen melanoma protocol transfers
